## gcode_macro GET_TIMELAPSE_SETUP

Assemble and print current timelapse settings. This changes no printer motion or heater state.

## gcode_macro _SET_TIMELAPSE_SETUP

Validate supplied timelapse options, derive park coordinates and update TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME variables. Select the renamed native pause/resume commands when available so camera parking can bypass operator filament-change handling.

**Calls and state references:** [PAUSE](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-pause), [RESUME](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-resume), [TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME](timelapse.cfg.md#gcode_macro-timelapse_take_frame). Conditional references are not necessarily executed.

**Runtime-selected calls:** <code>settings[&#x27;gcode_macro pause&#x27;].rename_existing</code>, <code>settings[&#x27;gcode_macro resume&#x27;].rename_existing</code>. Hook/state links above describe the known owners; external runtime values may select other commands.

<a id="gcode_macro-timelapse_take_frame"></a>

## gcode_macro TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME

When enabled and in the appropriate normal/hyperlapse mode, optionally retract and park, save movement state, request a camera frame and schedule completion checks. Remote callbacks and runtime setup determine actual operation; source defaults alone do not show that timelapse is enabled.

**Calls and state references:** [HYPERLAPSE](timelapse.cfg.md#gcode_macro-hyperlapse), [_TIMELAPSE_NEW_FRAME](timelapse.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_timelapse_new_frame), [_WAIT_TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME](timelapse.cfg.md#delayed_gcode-_wait_timelapse_take_frame), [_SET_TIMELAPSE_SETUP](timelapse.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_set_timelapse_setup), [PAUSE](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-pause). Conditional references are not necessarily executed.

**Runtime-selected calls:** <code>{macro.pause}</code>. Hook/state links above describe the known owners; external runtime values may select other commands.

Start or stop timer-based camera capture. Start stores the interval, schedules the next frame and immediately requests a frame; stop cancels the scheduled loop.

**Calls and state references:** [TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME](timelapse.cfg.md#gcode_macro-timelapse_take_frame), [_HYPERLAPSE_LOOP](timelapse.cfg.md#delayed_gcode-_hyperlapse_loop). Conditional references are not necessarily executed.

| [349](../config/timelapse.cfg#L349) | <code>{% set cycle = params.CYCLE&#124;default(30)&#124;int %}</code> | Calculate local <code>cycle</code> from <code>the supplied CYCLE argument (use 30 if absent) as an integer</code>. It lasts for this evaluation only. |

Only a true branch emits its commands. |
| [351](../config/timelapse.cfg#L351) | <code>{action_respond_info(&quot;Hyperlapse: frames started (Cycle %d sec)&quot; % cycle)}</code> | Write the shown message to the console during template evaluation; this is not a movement. |

<a id="delayed_gcode-_wait_timelapse_render"></a>

## delayed_gcode _WAIT_TIMELAPSE_RENDER

While rendering is pending, animate the display and check again after half a second. When the remote client clears the flag, clear the display and invoke the original resume command.

**Calls and state references:** [RESUME](mainsail.cfg.md#gcode_macro-resume), [TIMELAPSE_RENDER](timelapse.cfg.md#gcode_macro-timelapse_render). Conditional references are not necessarily executed.

**Runtime-selected calls:** <code>settings[&#x27;gcode_macro resume&#x27;].rename_existing</code>. Hook/state links above describe the known owners; external runtime values may select other commands.

| [395](../config/timelapse.cfg#L395) | <code>{% set ri = printer[&#x27;gcode_macro TIMELAPSE_RENDER&#x27;].run_identifier % 4 %}</code> | Reduce the render animation counter to one of four positions, selecting the next spinner character. |
| [396](../config/timelapse.cfg#L396) | <code>SET_GCODE_VARIABLE MACRO=TIMELAPSE_RENDER VARIABLE=run_identifier VALUE={ri + 1}</code> | Store <code>{ri + 1}</code> in the named macro's <code>run_identifier</code> variable for later calls. This changes runtime state, not the config file. |

<a id="gcode_macro-test_stream_delay"></a>

## gcode_macro TEST_STREAM_DELAY

If the recorded toolhead Z is above 5mm, move across X, wait the configured park delay and request a frame. Otherwise abort. Used to inspect camera latency; it is not a physical clearance validation.

**Calls and state references:** [TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME](timelapse.cfg.md#gcode_macro-timelapse_take_frame), [_TIMELAPSE_NEW_FRAME](timelapse.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_timelapse_new_frame). Conditional references are not necessarily executed.

| [420](../config/timelapse.cfg#L420) | <code>G0 X{min.x + 5.0} F{tl.speed.travel&#124;int * 60}</code> | command X=<code>{min.x + 5.0}</code> mm; use feed rate <code>{tl.speed.travel&#124;int * 60}</code> mm/min. XYZ follows G90/G91; E follows G91/M82/M83. Omitted axes and feed rate retain their previous values. |
